statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-97058 affects sprintf-js through 1.1.3, a transitive dependency of the Cassandra Reaper UI webpack toolchain. npm publishes no release above 1.1.3 yet and Docker Scout lists no fixed version; remediation depends on upstream sprintf-js or a broader Reaper UI dependency refresh.

CVE-2026-97058 affects sprintf-js through 1.1.3, a transitive dependency of the Cassandra Reaper UI webpack toolchain. npm publishes no release above 1.1.3 yet and Docker Scout lists no fixed version; remediation depends on upstream sprintf-js or a broader Reaper UI dependency refresh.

Docker Scout and the npm advisory list no patched release for sprintf-js within the affected range, and the teleport-web SPDX SBOM pins 1.0.3 as a transitive dependency of the Teleport web UI bundle. Impact and reachability of the improper quantity validation issue are under assessment until upstream or the teleport package build adopts a fixed release.

Impact and reachability of the improper quantity validation flaw are under assessment until upstream publishes a fix.

CVE-2026-97058 is reported against sprintf-js 1.1.3 and earlier; the npm registry latest release is still 1.1.3 with no patched version published. sprintf-js is a transitive dependency in the Directus production node_modules tree built into the directus-12 package consumed by this image. DHI will pin a fixed sprintf-js release via the directus package build when upstream publishes one and reassess runtime reachability for the API server deployment.
